performance.verdict: Leads and CPL improving, but 5 overdue milestones threaten attribution integrity.

findings.text: Pre-Launch Stack Test, LSA Verification, Site/Landing Pages (due 2026-07-31) and Ads Launch + Meta Retargeting (due 2026-08-01) — all 5 milestones remain unresolved, 46+ days overdue.
CPL dropped 30.39% to $154.39 over 28 days on 116.67% lead surge; 3-day signal (Sep 13–15) shows leads at 1/1/1 vs prior 3 days (Sep 10–12) at 4/3/2 — momentum is already softening.
GBP actions fell 55.32% week-over-week; last 3 days (Sep 13–15) show 0/0/0 GBP actions — organic discovery has gone dark while paid accelerated, suggesting profile suppression or data gap.

GHL shows 85 opportunities created but 0 won and 0 appointments over 28 days; 20 ad-reported leads vs 212 contacts suggests intake is not converting leads to consults — an intake leak, not an ads problem.

Google Ads reports only 6 conversions vs 20 total leads on $2,232.65 spend; GA4 shows 0 conversion events — pixel/conversion action is almost certainly misfiring, making ROAS and CPL attribution unreliable.

suggestions.text: Escalate all 5 overdue SOW milestones to Nacer immediately; LSA and pixel gaps block reliable attribution.
suggestions.monday_update: Five SOW milestones are 46+ days overdue: Pre-Launch Stack Test, LSA Verification, Site/Landing Pages, Ads Launch, and Meta Retargeting — all due by 2026-08-01. Google pixel is confirmed misfiring (6 Google conversions vs 20 total leads; GA4 shows 0 conversion events on $2,232.65 Google spend), making CPL data directional at best. Success is confirmed when Nacer signs off on stack test completion and Google/Meta conversion events fire end-to-end in a live test. Target resolution by 2026-09-23.

suggestions.text: Audit GHL intake: 85 opportunities, 0 appointments, 0 won — route and speed-to-lead SLA must be verified.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 85 opportunities created with 0 appointments booked and 0 cases won over 28 days, against 20 reported ad leads and 212 total contacts. This is an intake and routing failure, not an ads performance issue. Success is confirmed when at least 30% of new opportunities have a booked appointment within 5 minutes of lead arrival, per SOW speed-to-lead SLA. Review again by 2026-09-23.
